title: SCA Tribute to Rabbi Dr. Raymond Harari A"H by Mrs. Vicky Harari

chapters.title: Work and Gratitude
chapters.about: hard work in character refinement and expressing thanks

chapters.title: Inclusion of Women in Halakha
chapters.about: Talmud study for women and synagogue inclusion

chapters.title: Practicing Patience
chapters.about: giving time and attention to everyone

chapters.title: Focusing on Family
chapters.about: caring for children over public opinion

summary: Mrs. Vicky Harari shares six character traits practiced by her late husband, Rabbi Raymond Harari. She describes his commitment to daily Avoda, showing gratitude, forgiving others, including women within Halakha, exercising patience, and focusing on family over the opinions of others.
questions: Why was the second Bet HaMikdash destroyed?
What character traits did Rabbi Raymond Harari work on throughout his life?
How did Rabbi Raymond Harari approach forgiveness?
What was Rabbi Raymond Harari's view on including women in Halakhic study and prayer?
